content: millimeter accuracy on that position, really?

replies.content: I find it tends to slide around in the next step anyway, and it's easy to slide into alignment, so yeah, no need to measure too precisely here

update: just eye ball it close enough. the next step doesn't actually need mm precision.
----
If you're having trouble finding a ruler, the cheatsheet has a 270mm scale with a marker at 240mm. Split that in half -- close enough.
